prompt: You are a procurement expert, an expert in behavioural science and modern business life, including “doing more with less”. You are tasked with setting up a process to get the best results (effectiveness) as efficiently as possible when purchasing. Provide a recommendation
response: To maximize efficiency and effectiveness in procurement, streamline the process by reducing the number of suppliers to a bare minimum. This approach allows for easier management and potentially better terms due to increased business volume with fewer partners. Standardize procurement processes as much as possible to reduce variability and complexity.
